archive.packaging_note: The four packaging records, release/provenance.json, release/PROVENANCE.md, release/contents.json and release/SHA256SUMS, are regenerated after code_commit and merged as the next commit on main. The archive's bytes therefore equal the tree of that next commit, whose hash appears in the archive's file name. A record cannot name the commit that contains it.
